description: Stop a running sweep from doing any more work, keeping every result it has already written. Use it when the person has seen enough, or when a search turned out far larger than they wanted. It does not undo what already ran, and the results stay readable afterwards -- so it is a way to stop spending, not a way to take it back. Say how many runs finished, which is what they keep. A sweep that was only QUEUED had not started, so stopping it returns it to validated rather than paused and it can be launched again later.

experiment_id.description: The sweep, as create_sweep returned it.

name: pause_sweep
